We are looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help train and evaluate the next generation of AI coding agents. While modern AI coding agents are capable in many areas, they frequently miss edge cases, introduce brittle changes, write tests that pass for the wrong reasons, and require close supervision from an experienced engineer.  
In this role, you will bring the engineering judgment you have built shipping production systems to evaluate how AI coding agents handle real-world software engineering work inside realistic codebases. You will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own day-to-day experience—ranging from compact bug fixes to multi-day engineering scenarios—run them through frontier AI models, and grade the results against a professional standard.
